response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share_pct FROM status_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share_pct) AS share_pct FROM status_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share_pct) AS average_share_pct, AVG(s.share_pct - a.share_pct) AS average_excess_pct FROM status_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share_pct > a.share_pct;
